An unnamed, '''red colored wine''' was available on at least three different [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was enjoyed by members of both the higher and lower social classes.

==History==
This red [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Wine/Legends|wine]] was at the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="Corruption" /> the [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]],<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" /> an [[Unidentified Coruscant cantina/Legends|unnamed Coruscant cantina]] visited by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] and [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]];<ref name="Peace" /> and the [[Bilbousa saloon/Legends|Bilbousa saloon]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Friends" />

While dining at the Sundari Royal Palace, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] enjoyed the red wine poured from a bottle brought by the Duchess's servant. They celebrated the occasion by clinking their glasses in a [[Toast (ritual)/Legends|toast]].<ref name="Corruption" />

Chata Hyoki and Robonino were drinking entire bottles of the beverage when they were suddenly contacted by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] Senator [[Christo/Legends|Christo]] had several bottles of this beverage in [[Christo's apartment|his apartment]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and the senator helped himself to a glass of it during a meeting with [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]].<ref name="Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>
